title: Is Air a Mixture? Matter Explained Simply | PUC Chemistry Class 11
description:
A glass of water, the air you breathe and sweet tea all look smooth and even, but only one of them is a single pure substance. In this animated lesson for PUC and Class 11 Chemistry (NCERT Chapter 1, Some Basic Concepts of Chemistry) we answer the question from the last episode: is air a compound or a mixture?

You will see what matter is, how particles sit in solids, liquids and gases, and how one state turns into another. A sorting tree splits matter into mixtures (homogeneous and heterogeneous) and pure substances (elements and compounds). On the molecule bench we look inside air (about 78% nitrogen and 21% oxygen, with argon and a little carbon dioxide), then watch hydrogen and oxygen break their bonds and share electrons to make water, a new substance that puts out fire. A four step sorting key, a worked example that sorts six samples, the physical methods that separate mixtures (hand picking, filtration, crystallisation, distillation), the exam trap about O2, an original NEET pattern question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

This is Episode 3 of our PUC Chemistry series.

Made for PUC (Karnataka), CBSE Class 11, NEET and JEE Main students.
